title: Workforce analysis questions
body:
Come up with answers to Nathan's questions below and also think about how the future of this team should look like and what roles are missing and necessary to function.  Also, provide a visual to Nathan explaining the different roles of managing a product. 


What are the Knowledge Skills Abilities (KSAs) or your team? 
What competencies does your team provide and what value does it bring to ONRR in a support role?
What gaps currently exist in our program? 
What initiatives, laws, regulations, etc. does IDM need to adhere to now and in the future? (Ex: Open Data Act, Evidence Act, IDEA Act, Freedom of Information Act (FOIA), Privacy Act, etc.)
What recommendations do you have to gaps to support ONRR’s strategic goals?
Why should these processes stay centralized in IDM? 
How do we demonstrate synergies between Data Display, Data Governance, and DORC? 
How do we make the case that IDM’s current structure is what’s best for the organization?
author: Participant 1
